questions.exp: An author creates a book; a painter creates a painting.
A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut.
A kitten is the young one of a cat.
Entomology is the study of insects.
A glove covers the hand; a sock covers the foot.

questions.q: Statements: All cats are animals. All animals are living beings. Conclusion: All cats are living beings.
d: Only some cats are living beings
questions.exp: All A are B and all B are C gives all A are C.

questions.q: Statements: Some pens are blue. All blue things are bright. Which conclusion follows?
questions.exp: The blue pens are bright because all blue things are bright.

questions.q: Statements: No dog is a cat. All cats are pets. Which conclusion follows?
questions.exp: The cats are pets and none of them is a dog.

questions.q: Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Conclusion: Some roses fade quickly.
d: Follows only if all flowers fade
questions.exp: The flowers that fade quickly may not include any roses.
